text:
alexa: Planning note — external pentest week of 2024-05-06. Need: RBAC freeze window, minimal readroom with synthetic data, KMS access policy for assessors, and an auditable log export process. Scope: API ingress, control plane, console.

jamal: Proposed freeze: 2024-05-04 00:00Z -> 2024-05-08 23:59Z. Emergency changes only via ops oncall with two-person approval.

reece: For KMS I'll create an ephemeral principal `pen_test_assessor` scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/*` and restrict kms:Decrypt to artifacts prefix. Will post policy diff.

security-bot: Uploaded baseline checklist: https://s3.amazonaws.com/pt-bucket/checklist.md — expects key policy diff, IAM diff, log tarball, and sample queries per finding.

alexa: Audit export outline: snapshot CloudTrail + app-audit stream for the window, sign bundle (GPG), attach sha256, upload to evidence bucket, set 1yr retention flag in manifest. I'll run a dry-run this week.

ops-oncall: Operational note — will suspend autoscale-out and apply a rate limiter to public routes during the window. Enabling alert suppression rule `pt-noise-20240506`.

jamal: Remediation tracking: propose JIRA epic `PT2024-05-06` with tags `sec:pen-test` and `severity`. Each finding ticket must include PoF steps, a before/after log query, and a deployment timestamp. Retest policy: assessor retest starts 72h after fix verification.

reece: Sample policy (draft):
```
Version: 2012-10-17
Statement:
  - Effect: Allow
    Action: [kms:Decrypt,kms:DescribeKey]
    Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:000111:key/pt-2024
    Condition: {StringEquals: {kms:ViaService: s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com}}
  - Effect: Allow
    Action: s3:GetObject
    Resource: arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/*
```
Will tighten principal binding to `pen_test_assessor` and enable CloudTrail logging for Decrypt calls.

alexa: Deliverables before Fri Apr 26: policy PR, dry-run log tarball with checksum, JIRA epic created, runbook for emergency rollback snippets. Kickoff call Mon Apr 29 16:00 PT.

ops-oncall: For rollback, add snippet to runbook: `kubectl --context=prod rollout undo deployment/web --to-revision=<stable>` — requires sec + pm ack.

alexa: Good. Also: staging readroom will contain no real customer data; confirm synthetic tokenization and truncated traces only.

security-bot: Acknowledged. Will request assessor scoping call after artifacts are uploaded.

alexa: Thanks — ping here once dry-run tarball is uploaded and PR is open.
